jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132169 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. BACKGROUND Embark on a unique opportunity to actively contribute to the financial landscape of our Group Platforms department. In this transversal role, you will drive essential financial activities, primarily focusing on cost controlling, financial planning, and internal allocation model management. To succeed in this role, you should have a demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. 
• Your responsibilities will be dynamically split, with 70% dedicated to hands-on controlling tasks, working closely with managers to ensure financial rigor, and 30% focused on providing essential support to the wider controlling team, particularly in enhancing data quality and streamlining administrative functions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As part of Group Finance and based in Meyrin, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas: Drive Financial Performance & Control Oversee day-to-day financial operations for our technology domains and cost centers, ensuring efficient and appropriate financial control systems. Actively contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities, including preparing accruals, reviewing commitments, and assisting with allocation cycles. Partner closely with Group Technology Managers to foster cost awareness and enhance understanding of financial performance, providing insightful analysis and ad-hoc reports. Support the tracking and monitoring of resources for key technology projects and initiatives. Master Planning & Forecasting Play a key role in the planning and forecasting cycles (Budget, Latest Estimate, Roadmap), from data collection and analysis to presentation and report preparation. Assist in the review and consolidation of budget components (Investments, Operating expenses, Headcounts) for supported areas. Prepare preliminary management reports and conduct initial variance analysis against financial targets. Ensure Financial Integrity & Compliance Support the Capital Approval Request (CAR) process and contribute to the follow-up of financial commitments, including budget assumption validation and vendor contract checks. Assist in the control and validation of Purchase Orders (PO) in close collaboration with the P2P team. Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of cost allocation models, ensuring accurate evaluation of internal and business services. Support the application of Richemont's internal controlling procedures, identifying and addressing potential gaps. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Conduct regular and thorough checks on financial data quality within systems, particularly for time allocation entries and master data accuracy. Identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with stakeholders to resolve data integrity issues. Assist in collecting, validating, and consolidating financial data from various sources for reporting and analysis. Contribute to identifying and implementing process improvements within the controlling function, focusing on automation and efficiency. Provide support for ad-hoc financial analysis, data extraction, and special projects as required. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Strong team spirit and communication skills with aptitude to collaborate transversally across various teams, organizations, and stakeholders. Curious to learn, develop, and contribute to challenging the status-quo. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an ability to pay close attention to detail. Good organizational abilities with proactivity, and keen to work independently while managing ambiguity with guidance when necessary. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, and balance multiple priorities. Education, experience and core competencies University graduate in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. 1 to 3 years’ experience in a finance or controlling role, preferably within a multinational environment. Relevant internships will be considered. Familiarity with SAP FICO, Anaplan and/or BI tools is an asset. Knowledge of coding languages (like Python), AI prompts (Copilot), and/or RPA. Strong proficiency in Excel is required Demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. Fluent in English, French knowledge is a strong asset. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value curiosity, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, excellence, courage, collaboration, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Technology Procurement Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Watches & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR132169 Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. BACKGROUND Embarcarsi su un'opportunità unica per contribuire attivamente al paesaggio finanziario del nostro dipartimento Piattaforme di Gruppo. In questo ruolo trasversale, guiderai attività finanziarie essenziali, concentrando principalmente il controllo dei costi, la pianificazione finanziaria e la gestione del modello di allocazione interna. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si dovrebbe avere un interesse dimostrato per gli argomenti tecnologici, in particolare nelle aree di servizi digitali, infrastrutture e dati.
• Le tue responsabilità saranno divisi dinamicamente, con il 70% dedicato ai compiti di controllo pratico, lavorando vicino ai manager per garantire rigore finanziario, e il 30% incentrato sul fornire supporto essenziale al team di controllo della larghezza, in particolare nel migliorare la qualità dei dati e le funzioni amministrative di streaming. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Come parte del Gruppo Finanza e con sede a Meyrin, le vostre responsabilità comprenderanno, ma non sono limitate a, i seguenti settori chiave: Drive Financial Performance & Control Overseas operazioni finanziarie giornaliere per la nostra tecnologia home e centri di costo, garantendo sistemi di controllo finanziario efficienti e adeguati. Contribuisce attivamente alle attività di chiusura finanziaria mensili, trimestrali e annuali, tra cui la preparazione di incrementali, la revisione di impegni e l'assistenza con cicli di allocazione. Collabora con Group Technology Manager per promuovere la consapevolezza dei costi e migliorare la comprensione delle prestazioni finanziarie, fornendo analisi approfondite e report ad-hoc. Sostenere il monitoraggio e il monitoraggio delle risorse per i progetti e le iniziative di tecnologia chiave. Master Planning & Forecasting Gioca un ruolo chiave nei cicli di pianificazione e previsione (Budget, ultima stima, Roadmap), dalla raccolta e analisi dei dati alla preparazione di presentazione e report. Assistere nella revisione e consolidamento dei componenti di bilancio per le aree sostenute. La preparazione dei rapporti preliminari di gestione e l'analisi di variazione iniziale contro gli obiettivi finanziari. Garantire l'integrità finanziaria e la conformità Supporta il processo Capital Approval Request (CAR) e il contributo al follow-up di impegni finanziari, tra cui la validazione dell'assunzione di bilancio e i controlli contrattuali del venditore. Assistere nel controllo e nella convalida degli ordini di acquisto (PO) in stretta collaborazione con il team P2P. Contribuisce alla manutenzione e al miglioramento dei modelli di allocazione dei costi, garantendo una maggiore valutazione dei servizi interni e aziendali. Sostenere l'applicazione delle procedure interne di controllo di Richemont, identificare e affrontare potenziali lacune. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Condurre controlli regolari e approfonditi sulla qualità dei dati finanziari all'interno dei sistemi, specificamente per le voci di allocazione del tempo e la precisione dei dati master. Identificare le discrepanze, indagare le cause delle radici e collaborare con gli stakeholder per risolvere i problemi di integrità dei dati. Assistere nella raccolta, validazione e consolidamento dei dati finanziari da varie fonti per la segnalazione e l'analisi. Contribuire a identificare e implementare i miglioramenti dei processi all'interno della funzione di controllo, concentrandosi sull'automazione e sull'efficienza. Fornire supporto per l'analisi finanziaria ad-hoc, l'estrazione dei dati e progetti speciali come richiesto. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Competenze trasversali Forte spirito di squadra e capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di collaborare tra diverse squadre, organizzazioni e stakeholder. Curioso imparare, sviluppare e contribuire a vincere lo status quo. Forte capacità analitiche e quantitative, con la capacità di prestare molta attenzione ai dettagli. Buone capacità organizzative con produttività, e continuare a lavorare indipendentemente mentre gestiscono l'ambiguità con la guida quando necessario. Capacità di lavorare in modo efficace in un ambiente frenetico sotto linee strette, e bilanciare più priorità. Istruzione, esperienza e core concorsi Università laureato in Finanza, Contabilità, Business Administration, Ingegneria, o un campo correlato. Da 1 a 3 anni I rapporti internazionali saranno considerati. La familiarità con gli strumenti SAP FICO, Anaplan e/o BI è una risorsa. Conoscenza delle lingue di codifica (come Python), AI precoce (Copilota), e/o RPA. Una forte professionalità in Excel è necessaria Dimostrata interesse per gli argomenti tecnologici, in particolare nelle aree di servizi digitali, infrastrutturali e dati. Fluente in inglese, la conoscenza francese è un bene forte. Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra speciale capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Apprezziamo la curiosità, la collegialità, la lealtà e la solidarietà. Promuoviamo empatia, eccellenza, coraggio, collaborazione e integrità. Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo. Il nostro giorno con noi La vostra domanda sarà attentamente esaminata dai nostri team di reclutamento, che vi darà un follow-up a breve. Se il tuo profilo viene selezionato, ti contatteremo per un'intervista telefonica iniziale. Il prossimo passo sarà un'intervista con i Manager e il nostro HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Technology Procurement Internal Save Meyrin, Svizzera Richemont Orologi & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 mesi) Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 mesi) Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont

Beitrag zur Identifizierung und Implementierung von Prozessverbesserungen innerhalb der Controlling-Funktion mit Fokus auf Automatisierung und Effizienz. Unterstützung für Ad-hoc-Finanzanalysen, Datenextraktion und spezielle Projekte nach Bedarf. WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS? Reference code: JR132169 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. BACKGROUND Embark on a unique opportunity to actively contribute to the financial landscape of our Group Platforms department. In this transversal role, you will drive essential financial activities, primarily focusing on cost controlling, financial planning, and internal allocation model management. To succeed in this role, you should have a demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. 
• Your responsibilities will be dynamically split, with 70% dedicated to hands-on controlling tasks, working closely with managers to ensure financial rigor, and 30% focused on providing essential support to the wider controlling team, particularly in enhancing data quality and streamlining administrative functions. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As part of Group Finance and based in Meyrin, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas: Drive Financial Performance & Control Oversee day-to-day financial operations for our technology domains and cost centers, ensuring efficient and appropriate financial control systems. Actively contribute to monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities, including preparing accruals, reviewing commitments, and assisting with allocation cycles. Partner closely with Group Technology Managers to foster cost awareness and enhance understanding of financial performance, providing insightful analysis and ad-hoc reports. Support the tracking and monitoring of resources for key technology projects and initiatives. Master Planning & Forecasting Play a key role in the planning and forecasting cycles (Budget, Latest Estimate, Roadmap), from data collection and analysis to presentation and report preparation. Assist in the review and consolidation of budget components (Investments, Operating expenses, Headcounts) for supported areas. Prepare preliminary management reports and conduct initial variance analysis against financial targets. Ensure Financial Integrity & Compliance Support the Capital Approval Request (CAR) process and contribute to the follow-up of financial commitments, including budget assumption validation and vendor contract checks. Assist in the control and validation of Purchase Orders (PO) in close collaboration with the P2P team. Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of cost allocation models, ensuring accurate evaluation of internal and business services. Support the application of Richemont's internal controlling procedures, identifying and addressing potential gaps. Champion Data Quality & Process Improvement Conduct regular and thorough checks on financial data quality within systems, particularly for time allocation entries and master data accuracy. Identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with stakeholders to resolve data integrity issues. Assist in collecting, validating, and consolidating financial data from various sources for reporting and analysis. Contribute to identifying and implementing process improvements within the controlling function, focusing on automation and efficiency. Provide support for ad-hoc financial analysis, data extraction, and special projects as required. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Transversal skills Strong team spirit and communication skills with aptitude to collaborate transversally across various teams, organizations, and stakeholders. Curious to learn, develop, and contribute to challenging the status-quo. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an ability to pay close attention to detail. Good organizational abilities with proactivity, and keen to work independently while managing ambiguity with guidance when necessary. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment under tight deadlines, and balance multiple priorities. Education, experience and core competencies University graduate in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. 1 to 3 years’ experience in a finance or controlling role, preferably within a multinational environment. Relevant internships will be considered. Familiarity with SAP FICO, Anaplan and/or BI tools is an asset. Knowledge of coding languages (like Python), AI prompts (Copilot), and/or RPA. Strong proficiency in Excel is required Demonstrated interest in Technology topics, particularly in Digital, Infrastructure, and Data services areas. Fluent in English, French knowledge is a strong asset. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value curiosity, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. We foster empathy, excellence, courage, collaboration, and integrity. We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Technology Procurement Intern Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Watches & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR132208 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT As a Test Manager intern, you will become a key member of our Quality Assurance team, contributing to the harmonisation of testing practices and the exploration and implementation of AI-driven testing solutions across our domain. You will work closely with an existing Test Manager, embedded in a Product team, reporting to a senior member of the QA leadership. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? (Mention 3 quantitative responsibilities) By bringing valuable insights and a quality-focused mindset, you will contribute to the evolution of our testing landscape. Support the harmonisation of testing methodologies: Assist in documenting, standardizing, and promoting best practices for testing within & across various product teams, aiming for improved efficiency and consistency in our ways of working. Contribute to AI for testing initiatives: Participate in the research, exploration, and initial implementation phases of AI-powered testing tools and strategies, helping to identify potential use cases and measure their impact on testing efficiency and coverage. Collaborate with Test Managers embedded in Product Areas: Work alongside embedded Test Managers to understand their specific testing challenges, gather requirements for harmonisation efforts, and support the integration of new testing approaches and tools. Assist in the preparation of test strategies, test plans, and test reports. Help organize and facilitate workshops or training sessions related to new testing tools or methodologies. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? (What skills do they need to succeed) You are doing a master's degree or are recently graduated (Business or Engineering School) with a strong interest in software quality assurance, testing methodologies, and emerging technologies like AI. You can follow a rapid learning curve and show impactful results (be a doer) after a short discovery phase. You can understand transversal topics from IT to Business requirements, with an ability to grasp the big picture of quality assurance within a large organization. You have a quality-orientated mindset, with an eye for detail and can propose improvements in our testing processes and deliverables. You are effective in communication and can work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and other test managers. You have a strong team spirit, you are proactive, enthusiastic, and not afraid of new challenges in a dynamic environment. Eager to master Test Management and Quality Assurance within an IT environment Skilled in Microsoft 360 (Teams, PowerPoint, Excel & Word), know-how of Atlassian Suite is a bonus. Strong proficiency in English and French is a must. You are available for a 6-month internship with a start date in April 2026 You are eligible for an internship agreement. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? (Work environment and culture) At Richemont, we believe in fostering an environment where every team member can thrive and feel valued. As an Intern Test Manager, you will: Be part of a dynamic and supportive team: Enjoy the various personalities of our team, participate in regular team events, and engage in a variety of activities that promote collaboration and camaraderie. Benefit from mentorship and learning: Work closely with experienced professionals who are dedicated to your growth, providing guidance and opportunities to expand your skills in quality assurance and AI for testing. Contribute to meaningful projects: Your work will directly impact the quality and efficiency of our different scope of activities, giving you a sense of purpose and achievement. Enjoy a stimulating and innovative atmosphere: Be at the forefront of exploring new technologies like AI in testing, contributing to the future of quality assurance within a leading luxury group. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: 1. If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. 2. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR132208 Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. CONTESTO Come Test Manager internamente, diventerai un membro chiave del nostro team di Quality Assurance, contribuendo all'armonizzazione delle pratiche di test e all'esplorazione e all'implementazione di soluzioni di test basate su AI in tutto il nostro dominio. Potrai lavorare vicino a un Test Manager esistente, incorporato in un team di prodotto, segnalando a un membro senior della leadership QA. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Attraverso preziose intuizioni e una mentalità focalizzata sulla qualità, contribuirai all'evoluzione del nostro paesaggio di test. Sostenere l'armonizzazione dei metodi di test: aiutare a documentare, standardizzare e promuovere le migliori pratiche di collaudo all'interno e all'interno di vari team di prodotti, cercando una migliore efficienza e coerenza nei nostri modi di lavorare. Contribuisci all'IA per le iniziative di test: Partecipa alle fasi di ricerca, esplorazione e implementazione iniziale di strumenti e strategie di test alimentati dall'IA, aiutando a identificare i potenziali casi di utilizzo e misurarne l'impatto sull'efficienza e la copertura dei test. Collabora con Test Manager incorporati nelle aree di prodotto: lavorare lungo i test manager incorporati per comprendere le loro specifiche sfide di test, altri requisiti per gli sforzi di armonizzazione e sostenere l'integrazione di nuovi approcci e strumenti di test. Assistere nella preparazione di strategie di prova, piani di prova e rapporti di prova. Aiuta a organizzare e facilitare workshop o sessioni di formazione relative a nuovi strumenti di prova o metodi. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? (Che abilità hanno bisogno di avere successo) State facendo un master o siete recentemente laureati (Business o Engineering School) con un forte interesse per la garanzia della qualità del software, metodi di test e tecnologie emergenti come AI. È possibile seguire una curva di apprendimento rapida e mostrare risultati di impatto (essere un doer) dopo una breve fase di scoperta. È possibile comprendere argomenti trasversali da IT a requisiti aziendali, con la capacità di cogliere il grande quadro di garanzia della qualità all'interno di un'ampia organizzazione. Hai una mentalità orientata alla qualità, con un occhio per i dettagli e può proporre miglioramenti nei nostri processi di test e consegnabili. Sei efficace nella comunicazione e può lavorare vicino a team interfunzionali, tra cui sviluppatori, proprietari di prodotti e altri responsabili di test. Hai uno spirito di squadra forte, sei proattivo, entusiasta e non hai paura di nuove sfide in un ambiente dinamico. Impaziente di master Test Management e Quality Assurance all'interno di un ambiente IT Abilitato in Microsoft 360 (Teams, PowerPoint, Excel & Word), il know-how di Atlasian Suite è un bonus. Una forte professionalità in inglese e francese è un must. Siete disponibili per uno stage di 6 mesi con una data di inizio nell'aprile 2026 Siete idonei per un accordo di stage. Come ti battiamo? (ambiente di lavoro e cultura) A Richemont, crediamo in promuovere un ambiente in cui ogni membro del team può tre e sentirsi apprezzato. In qualità di Responsabile Test Interno, farai parte di un team dinamico e di supporto: goditi le varie personalità del nostro team, partecipi agli eventi di squadra regolari e ti impegni in una varietà di attività che promuovono la collaborazione e la camaraderie. Approfittate del mentoring e dell'apprendimento: Lavorate vicino a professionisti esperti che sono dedicati alla vostra crescita, fornendo indicazioni e opportunità per espandere le vostre competenze nell'assicurazione della qualità e nell'intelligenza artificiale per i test. Contribuisci a progetti meeting: il tuo lavoro influenzerà direttamente la qualità e l'efficienza delle nostre diverse attività, dandoti un senso di scopo e di realizzazione. jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132340 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. As part of its strategic development in Switzerland, Buccellati is looking for a Boutique Manager capable to handle the opening and success of the boutique. Your mission: As an Ambassador of the Buccellati Maison, you will be responsible of the development and optimization of the boutique performance and profitability by managing the boutique team, ensuring excellence in boutique operations and in delivering the best client service and experience. You will contribute in developing a deep understanding and knowledge of the Maison to convey its brand DNA, recognizable craftmanship and innovation in all its creations. You will be in charge of the daily operations of the boutique (front and back office) with the aim to communicate the overall brand message in a successful manner to generate business. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining and promoting the Buccellati brand image and identity, following the Company’s directives. You will be accountable for ensuring maximum sales and profitability of the boutique through merchandise, inventory, expense control and human resources management. Your Key 
• Responsibilities: Boutique performance & Sales achievement: Achieve or surpass monthly and yearly sales targets of the boutique; Meet or exceed the KPI’s set by Retail Management; Respect the brand’s discount policy; Establish budget, track sales and expenses. Maintain budget and related costs within established guidelines; Develop and implement the boutique action plan with the commercial department with a focus on business development; Ensure the sales growth; Gain market share; Review competition trends, recommend and initiate changes for maximizing goals and objectives; Management: Set, implement and supervise the Boutique sales strategy; Guarantee the implementation and regular monitoring of the Boutique action plan (Result driven, monthly review and keep update, monitor and follow up the plan); Ensure compliance with all policies and procedures through regular store management and staff meetings, store walk-through, audits .. ; Together with the Visual Merchandising Team, ensure that the standards on store image are kept according to Company guidelines and coordinate the proper training for sales staff; Ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels; Ensure proper attire, grooming and behavior in line with the brand’s guidelines; Grant the compliance to operational procedures provided by the Group; Lead by example & Team spirit: lead and motivate the team to accomplish and maximize the sales target and retail KPIs; Oversee the boutique maintenance; Handle all customer’s enquiries and complaints; Customer Relations Management: Treat the customer according to brand’s standards: ensure that each customer receives outstanding standards, solid product knowledge and all other components of Customer Service; Act as a Brand Ambassador when representing the Brand at meetings, events (local & international) and other work-related functions; Build strong customer relationships and enhance loyalty; Acquire a relevant customer database, convert into sales transaction and retain the customer for future transactions; Monitor & execute the Boutique CRM program; Team Management: Performs all necessary supervisory functions to effectively and efficiently manage the personnel assigned: Hire, lead and act as advisor to boutique team regarding projects, tasks and operations; Define and communicate missions and objectives of all team members, clearly establishing priorities and reasonable deadlines; Formulate sales team’s goals and objectives, motivate staff and reinforce engagement; Motivate the boutique team around the strategy and vision of the Maison; Fosters a cooperative and harmonious working climate to maximize employees morale and productivity; Act as a coach and assist the colleagues in operations, sales and training; Job profile: Bachelor graduated with at least 10 years retail experience, preferably in luxury jewelry/watchmaking sector; Qualification/ training in watches & jewelry, knowledge of diamond grading and design; Preferably with qualification in gemology; Ability to work in a fast-paced retail store environment; MS Office experience required (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Fluency in English and French is mandatory; the knowledge of another language is a plus (Arabic, Chinese, Russian, Italian); Personal Skills: Managerial skills and proactive approach; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are required; Ability to delegate tasks and follow up to ensure execution; People friendly and comfortable dealing with VIP clients; Excellent representation skills; Focused, target oriented and organized; Strong understanding of Customer Service needs and Customer (internal and external) priorities; Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and with precision; Self-Starter with Team-Player approach; Similar Jobs Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Senior Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Stock Administrator Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati

jobs.title: Intern Team Performance Training (100%)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132397 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Team Performance Training Department we are looking for an INTERN TEAM PERFORMANCE TRAINING (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: November 2026 In this stimulating internship, you are working on HQ Team Performance Training projects while being in close contact with our international platforms, giving a global dimension to this position. The role is allocated within the Global Commercial Team and reports directly to the Global Head of Team Performance and Digital Training. YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Ad-hoc analysis of global commercial KPIs. Preparation and analysis of sales data for market coaching, market visits and executive management presentations. Creation and further development of existing coaching and training tools, content, roadmaps, tracking, feedback coordination, etc. Support with creation of digital training content via our internal app and presentation content related to product, service and performance. Support virtual studio operation and creation of studio presentations. Organization and coordination of large HQ-trainings (approx. 2-3 trainings per internship). Support for the Team Performance Training Team with additional needs in administration, budgeting, reporting, new project management etc. HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. 
• Your profile should combine both quantitative (e.g., analytical thinking, number crunching, etc.) and qualitative (e.g., creative ideas, design affinity, etc.) skills: Currently enrolled or recently graduated from a bachelor's or master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Sales, Hospitality or similar. First experience in the field of Sales / Retail / Marketing / Finance / Consulting is a plus. Team player with strong analytical and project management skills. Independent, dedicated and highly motivated individual with a high affinity for our brand and strong enthusiasm for our products. Proactive and flexible mindset with a hands-on mentality. Very strong digital tool knowledge and at ease with different software solutions, especially Excel and PowerPoint (SAP knowledge is an asset). Fluent in English (excellent written and verbal communication) is a must and any other language is a plus. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. IWC offers you a challenging working environment: rooted in Switzerland, but operating successfully internationally. We combine tradition with innovation and attach great importance to change management, training and further education as well as personal development. Find below a selection of fringe benefits provided by us: Daily food & beverage allowance of CHF 7, redeem-able in the in-house restaurant and selected restaurants in Schaffhausen. Yearly health insurance contribution of CHF 2'340 for full-time contracts. 25 days vacation annually (30 days as of the age of 50), 5 additional bridge compensation days. Special conditions on selected IWC & Richemont products. Diverse health & wellbeing initiatives and programs, including financial support for external childcare. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) for sport enthusiasts. Attractive workplace adjacent to the river rhine, inviting for social activities amongst colleagues. Memorable internal events (Christmas, summer after work drinks, etc.). And many more! descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR132397 Siamo produttori. Pensatori. Strateghi. Storytellers. Da oltre 150 anni, siamo stati plasmati dalla tradizione, alimentati dal progresso e guidati dalle persone. Unisciti a noi come celebriamo l'eredità dell'artigianato e il futuro dell'orologeria, dove ogni zecca risuona con il battito del tempo stesso. Ovunque sia iniziata la tua strada, ci interessa dove vuoi andare. Che si tratti di Schaffhausen o di qualche altra parte del mondo, ingegnere il tuo prossimo passo con noi. Per sostenere il nostro Team Performance Training Department stiamo cercando un INTERN TEAM PERFORMANCE TRAINING (100%) Durata: 6 mesi Inizio: Novembre 2026 In questo stimolante tirocinio, si sta lavorando a progetti HQ Team Performance Training, mentre si trova in stretto contatto con le nostre piattaforme internazionali, dando una dimensione globale a questa posizione. Il ruolo è assegnato all'interno del Global Commercial Team e riferisce direttamente al Global Head of Team Performance e Digital Training. La tua missione a IWC. Analisi ad-hoc dei KPI commerciali globali. Preparazione e analisi dei dati di vendita per coaching di mercato, visite di mercato e presentazioni di gestione esecutiva. Creazione e sviluppo di strumenti di coaching e formazione esistenti, contenuti, roadmap, monitoraggio, coordinamento feedback, ecc. Supporto con la creazione di contenuti di formazione digitale tramite la nostra app interna e contenuti di presentazione relativi a prodotto, servizio e prestazioni. Supporta il funzionamento dello studio virtuale e la creazione di presentazioni di studio. Organizzazione e coordinamento delle grandi formazioni HQ (circa 2-3 allenamenti per stage). Supporto per il Team Performance Training Team con ulteriori esigenze in amministrazione, budgeting, reporting, nuova gestione del progetto ecc. Come fai a essere parte del Giornale.
• Il vostro profilo dovrebbe combinare sia le capacità quantitative (ad esempio, il pensiero analitico, il cronching del numero, ecc.) e qualitative (ad esempio, idee creative, affinità di progettazione, ecc.): Attualmente iscritta o recentemente laureata in Business, Economia, Marketing, Vendite, Ospitalità o simili. La prima esperienza nel campo delle vendite / vendita al dettaglio / marketing / finanza / consulenza è un plus. Giocatore di squadra con forti capacità di gestione analitica e di progetto. Individuale indipendente, dedicato e altamente motivato con un'alta affinità per il nostro marchio e forte entusiasmo per i nostri prodotti. Mindset proattivo e flessibile con una mentalità hands-on. Conoscenza digitale molto forte e a suo agio con diverse soluzioni software, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint (la conoscenza SAP è un bene). Fluente in inglese (eccellente comunicazione scritta e verbale) è un must e qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus. Quello che puoi immaginare da noi. IWC vi offre un ambiente di lavoro impegnativo: radicato in Svizzera, ma operativo con successo a livello internazionale. Uniamo la tradizione all'innovazione e attribuiamo grande importanza al cambiamento di gestione, formazione e formazione, nonché allo sviluppo personale. Di seguito troverai una selezione dei vantaggi offerti da noi: Quotidiano indennizzo di cibo e bevande di CHF 7, riscattabile nel ristorante interno e ristoranti selezionati a Schaffhausen. Contributo annuale di assicurazione sanitaria di CHF 2'340 per contratti a tempo pieno. 25 giorni di vacanza all'anno (30 giorni a partire dall'età di 50), 5 giorni aggiuntivi di compensazione del ponte. Condizioni speciali sui prodotti selezionati IWC & Richemont. Diverse iniziative e programmi di salute e benessere, tra cui il supporto finanziario per l'assistenza all'infanzia esterna. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) per gli appassionati di sport. Posto di lavoro attraente adiacente alla renna del fiume, invitante per le attività sociali tra colleghi. Eventi interni memorabili (Natale, estate dopo bevande di lavoro, ecc.). E molti altri! Code de référence: JR132397 Nous sommes des fabricants. Des penseurs. Des stratèges. Des conteurs. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous avons été façonnés par la tradition, alimentés par le progrès et animés par les gens. Rejoignez-nous alors que nous célébrons l'héritage de l'artisanat et l'avenir de l'horlogerie, où chaque tique résonne avec le rythme du temps lui-même. Où que votre chemin ait commencé, nous nous soucions où vous voulez aller. Que ce soit à Schaffhausen ou ailleurs dans le monde, préparez votre prochaine étape avec nous. Pour soutenir notre service de formation au rendement de l'équipe, nous cherchons une formation INTERNE EN RENDEMENT (100 %) Durée : 6 mois Début : novembre 2026 Dans ce stage stimulant, vous travaillez sur des projets de formation à la performance de l'équipe HQ tout en étant en contact étroit avec nos plateformes internationales, donnant une dimension globale à ce poste. Le rôle est attribué au sein de l'équipe commerciale mondiale et relève directement du chef de l'équipe mondiale Performance et formation numérique. Votre mission à IWC. Analyse ad hoc des ICR commerciaux mondiaux. Préparation et analyse des données de vente pour le coaching du marché, les visites de marché et les présentations de cadres supérieurs. Création et développement d'outils de coaching et de formation existants, contenu, feuilles de route, suivi, coordination des retours, etc. Soutien à la création de contenu de formation numérique via notre application interne et le contenu de présentation liés au produit, service et performance. Soutenir le fonctionnement du studio virtuel et la création de présentations en studio. Organisation et coordination de grandes formations au QG (environ 2-3 formations par stage). Appui à l'équipe de formation aux performances de l'équipe qui a des besoins supplémentaires en matière d'administration, de budgétisation, d'établissement de rapports, de nouvelle gestion de projet, etc. Comme vous avez fait partie de la journée.
• Votre profil devrait combiner à la fois les compétences quantitatives (p. ex., la pensée analytique, le calcul des nombres, etc.) et qualitatives (p. ex., les idées créatives, l'affinité du design, etc.) : actuellement inscrits ou récemment diplômés d'un baccalauréat ou d'un master en affaires, économie, marketing, ventes, hospitalité ou similaire. Première expérience dans le domaine des ventes / Détail / Marketing / Finance / Conseil est un plus. Joueur d'équipe avec de solides compétences en analyse et gestion de projet. Individuel indépendant, dévoué et très motivé avec une grande affinité pour notre marque et un vif enthousiasme pour nos produits. Un état d'esprit proactif et flexible avec une mentalité pratique. Très forte connaissance des outils numériques et à l'aise avec les différentes solutions logicielles, en particulier Excel et PowerPoint (la connaissance du PAS est un atout). L'anglais (excellente communication écrite et verbale) est un must et toute autre langue est un plus. Ce que vous pouvez attendre de nous. IWC vous offre un environnement de travail stimulant : enraciné en Suisse, mais fonctionnant avec succès à l'international. Nous associons tradition et innovation et attachons une grande importance à la gestion du changement, à la formation et à la formation continue ainsi qu'au développement personnel. Retrouvez ci-dessous une sélection d'avantages sociaux offerts par nous : Indemnité alimentaire quotidienne de CHF 7, échangeable dans le restaurant et restaurants sélectionnés à Schaffhausen. Contribution annuelle d'assurance maladie de CHF 2'340 pour les contrats à temps plein. 25 jours de vacances par an (30 jours à partir de l'âge de 50 ans), 5 jours supplémentaires de compensation de pont. Conditions spéciales pour certains produits IWC & Richemont. Initiatives et programmes diversifiés en matière de santé et de bien-être, y compris un soutien financier pour les garderies externes. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) pour les amateurs de sport. Des lieux de travail attrayants à côté du rhinocéros, invitant à des activités sociales entre collègues. Manifestations internes mémorables (Noël, boissons de l'été après le travail, etc.). Et bien d'autres ! jobs.title: Upstream Supply Chain Project Intern
jobs.description: Reference code: JR132495 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXT Supply Chain is a key driver of Maisons’ overall performance. It must be agile to provide the best end-to-end product availability and ensure client satisfaction, anytime and anywhere. Group Supply Chain Solutions act as an internal consulting branch, supporting Maisons in their transformation ambitions. Our mission: foster Supply Chain transformation to strengthen Maisons’ competitive advantage. You will discover in Richemont a strong manufacturing ecosystem and work closely with the Maisons and the internal manufactures HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will promote analytics & reporting tools Create, improve and maintain the upstream analytics and reporting tools Support Maison’s to leverage the analytics and reporting tools implemented Contribute to ongoing projects Support the preparation and animation of workshops Run ad-hoc analysis to support ongoing projects and bring data-base insights to the team Formalize outputs of analysis/workshop to prepare steering comittees You will support the Upstream growth and structuring Co-design and build methodological kit of our best practices Build user guide for our in-house tools Create communication support to promote initiatives internally WHAT ARE THE EXCEPTIONAL SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR? Enrolled in the last year of a Master’s degree or equivalent in engineering Industrial Supply Chain experience/knowledge Good organization and communication skills Appetence for data-analytics combined with solid analytical skills Solid dashboard/visualization tool skills (PowerBI) SQL basics are a plus Fluent in English and French HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You will work with diverse teams and have the opportunity to learn about a wide variety of domains. You will gain insights into the luxury industry from the perspective of one of the global leaders that is bridging more than two thousand years of heritage with cutting edge innovation. Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Geneva, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132531 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. We are looking for enthusiastic, passionate, dynamic people to join our new retail team in Geneva! Main purpose: The Boutique Sales Associate is a fully engaged individual who is committed to contributing to the success of the opening of the new Buccellati boutique in Geneva, with the ambition to grow with the Maison. If you are looking for an opportunity to enter the world of High Jewellery, craftmanship and you are curious to learn more, this role has a lot to offer. Your mission will be to promote the Buccellati brand image as per the Company’s directives. Your mission: You will become a Brand Ambassador of Buccellati Maison in the Boutique as well as at external events, and you will be responsible for delivering a unique client experience by sharing memorable inspiring moments. You will foster trusted relationships with clients all along the journey with the Maison. You will contribute in developing a deep understanding and knowledge of the Maison to convey its brand DNA, recognizable craftmanship and innovation in all its creations. You will be part of a team, transmitting and sharing knowledge with the other team members, actively participating in the day-to-day boutique life. Your 
• Responsibilities: Sales performance & customer service: Contribute to the boutique achieving its sales targets; Assist clients with Customer Service needs maintaining the brands high standards; Cultivate strong client relationships, delivering outstanding client service and treatment; providing a friendly environment which includes greeting and acknowledging every customer, maintaining outstanding standards and solid product knowledge; Adapt approach according to the client needs and motivations; Assist and support after sales clients in accordance with Maison values; provide recommendations that will provide an exceptional client experience; 2. Stock management and merchandising: Provide feedback in processing and replenishing merchandise; participate in receiving and monitoring floor stock; Actively participate in the visual merchandising of the Boutique implementing required guidelines. Assist in floor moves, merchandising, display maintenance, and store housekeeping, including cleaning the products and displays; Assist in the inventory process, including but not limited to stock counting and special projects as needed; Assist in completing prices changes within the Boutique when required; 3. Boutique operations and cash management: Accurately and efficiently complete all sales transactions and maintain proper cash records at the Boutique’s register; Adhere to all Company policies, procedures and practices; Implement discounts and gratuities under supervision of Boutique manager; Comply with all safety regulations and Boutique operational procedures including security; 4. Product knowledge & sales techniques: Maintain an awareness of all product knowledge information; Master the Brand's sales techniques as per training received; Attendance to required training; 5. Presentation & visibility: Maintain boutique tidiness, decoration and visual merchandising in line with Brand guidelines; Report maintenance issues to the Boutique Manager; Represent the Brand by wearing the appropriate provided uniform; Represent the Brand instore and at local events under the direction of Boutique Manager; Your 
• Profile: 2 to 5 years of previous experience in luxury retail, ideally in the Jewellery universe; Ability to work in a fast-paced retail store environment MS Office experience required; Fluency in French and English is mandatory, Italian is an advantage; Strong knowledge of local clientele; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are required; Confidence in handling high-value transactions; Strong understanding of Customer Service needs and Customer (internal and external) priorities; Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and with precision; Self-Starter with Team-Player approach; Must be available to work retail hours including in the evenings, during weekends and to travel for trainings, client events, conferences; Similar Jobs Boutique Manager Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Senior Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Sales Associate Save Tivoli, Italy Buccellati

jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132493 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we believe in the power of dreams and the artistry of emotion. We are seeking a dedicated and elegant individual to join our Maison in Zurich as a Sales Associate. If you are passionate about exceptional service and the enchanting world of High Jewellery, we invite you to discover this unique opportunity. Do you match this profile? You are adaptable, an empathetic communicator, and an attentive listener, embodying the grace and care synonymous with our Maison. You possess a deep passion for the enchanting world of High Jewellery, the unique universe of Van Cleef & Arpels, and the exquisite artistry of craftsmanship. You are naturally at ease in a refined boutique environment, engaging with a diverse clientele during their boutique visits and high-profile events, both international and local, with discernment and warmth. You are seeking a collaborative and benevolent team environment where a shared passion for exceptional client care contributes to a truly harmonious atmosphere. You hold a university degree and speak fluent Swiss German, German, and English, and proficiency in a fourth language will be a strong advantage. You possess proven experience within luxury jewellery or watches Maisons, demonstrating an innate understanding of sophisticated service and elegance. A genuine appreciation for the world of high jewellery, luxury goods, and the unique savoir-faire that defines Van Cleef & Arpels. Interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to articulate the Maison's heritage and creations with elegance and conviction, allowing you to create a long lasting relationship with the clients. A natural ability to anticipate and exceed the expectations of a sophisticated clientele, delivering an unparalleled client experience. Proficient in using IT tools such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint and email. If so, we would love to get to know you! What do we expect from you? As a Sales Associate in our boutique, you are the voice of Van Cleef & Arpels for our clients, and you build and maintain strong relationships with them. You are an ambassador of the Maison, promoting its image both internally and externally. You demonstrate excellent commercial acumen and actively participate in the recruitment and development of new clients. You aim to offer a unique experience to our loyal clients. You convey the refinement, elegance, and innovation that inspire the Maison's creations. You leverage your passion for history and art, complemented by a breadth of general knowledge, to cultivate exceptional bonds with our most discerning clientele More than a job... an experience! Joining Van Cleef & Arpels means becoming part of a revered Maison where the growth and flourishing of our talents are paramount. You will embark on a comprehensive onboarding journey, offering a rich tapestry of training on our illustrious history, unparalleled savoir-faire, and iconic creations, complemented by continuous daily support within a benevolent and collaborative environment. We believe in recognizing exceptional talent and dedication.

Bezugscode: JR132493 Wer sind wir? Ein Hochschmuckhaus mit einem starken Erbe, das außergewöhnliches Know-how in einer bezaubernden und kreativen Umgebung fördert. Unser Haus sucht talentierte Personen, die dazu beitragen, ihr Fachwissen mit Sorgfalt und ohne Kompromisse zu entwickeln und weiterzugeben. Bei Van Cleef & Arpels werden Sie von leidenschaftlichen Experten umgeben sein und zu vielen neuen Projekten beitragen, die es unserem Haus ermöglichen, sich regelmäßig neu zu erfinden. Bei Van Cleef & Arpels sind wir stolz darauf, Talente aus vielen verschiedenen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen zu gewinnen. Wir glauben, dass, wenn Vielfalt und Inklusion vollständig angenommen und gestärkt werden, Kreativität und Wissen entstehen, um Exzellenz zu liefern. Bei Van Cleef & Arpels glauben wir an die Kraft der Träume und die Kunst der Emotionen. Wir sehen eine engagierte und elegante Person, die sich unserem Home in Zürich als Sales Associate anschließt. Wenn Sie sich für außergewöhnlichen Service und die bezaubernde Welt des Hochschmucks begeistern, laden wir Sie ein, diese einzigartige Gelegenheit zu entdecken. Passen Sie zu diesem Profil? Sie sind anpassungsfähig, ein empathischer Kommunikator und ein aufmerksamer Listener, der die Gnade und Fürsorge verkörpert, die mit unserer Maison gleichbedeutend ist. Sie haben eine tiefe Leidenschaft für die bezaubernde Welt des Hochschmucks, das einzigartige Universum von Van Cleef & Arpels und die exquisite Kunst des Handwerks. Sie sind natürlich in einer raffinierten Boutique-Umgebung, die sich mit einer vielfältigen Kundschaft während ihrer Boutique-Besuche und hochkarätigen Veranstaltungen, sowohl international als auch lokal, mit Urteilsvermögen und Wärme. Sie sehen eine kooperative und vorteilhafte Teamumgebung, in der eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft für außergewöhnliche Kundenbetreuungsmitarbeiter zu einer wirklich harmonischen Atmosphäre beiträgt. Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss und sprechen fließend Schweizerdeutsch, Deutsch und Englisch, und die Fakultät in einer vierten Sprache wird ein großer Vorteil sein. Sie besitzen nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Luxus-Schmuck oder Uhren Häuser, zeigt ein angeborenes Verständnis von anspruchsvollen Service und Eleganz. Eine echte Wertschätzung für die Welt des hohen Schmucks, der Luxusgüter und des einzigartigen Know-hows, das Van Cleef & Arpels ausmacht. Zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, das Erbe und die Kreationen der Maison mit Eleganz und Überzeugung zu artikulieren, so dass Sie eine lange Beziehung zu den Kunden aufbauen können. Eine natürliche Fähigkeit, die Erwartungen einer anspruchsvollen Kundschaft zu antizipieren und zu übertreffen und eine beispiellose Kundenerfahrung zu bieten. Proficient in der Verwendung von IT-Tools wie Excel, Word, PowerPoint und E-Mail. Wenn ja, würden wir Sie gerne kennenlernen! Was erwarten wir von Ihnen? Als Sales Associate in unserer Boutique sind Sie die Stimme von Van Cleef & Arpels für unsere Kunden, und Sie bauen und pflegen starke Beziehungen zu ihnen. Sie sind Botschafter der Maison und fördern ihr Image sowohl intern als auch extern. Sie zeigen exzellenten Geschäftssinn und beteiligen sich aktiv an der Rekrutierung und Entwicklung neuer Kunden. Sie möchten unseren treuen Kunden ein einzigartiges Erlebnis bieten. Sie vermitteln die Raffinesse, Eleganz und Innovation, die die Kreationen der Maison inspiriert. Sie heben Ihre Leidenschaft für Geschichte und Kunst, ergänzt durch Kenntnisse des Allgemeinwissens, um außergewöhnliche Bindungen zu unserer anspruchsvollsten Klientel zu pflegen Mehr als ein Job... eine Erfahrung! Der Beitritt zu Van Cleef & Arpels bedeutet, Teil eines überarbeiteten Hauses zu werden, in dem das Wachstum und die Verwischung unserer Talente von größter Bedeutung sind. Sie begeben sich auf eine umfassende Onboarding-Reise und bieten einen reichhaltigen Teppich aus Schulungen zu unserer illustren Geschichte, beispiellosem Know-how und ikonischen Kreationen, ergänzt durch kontinuierliche tägliche Unterstützung in einer positiven und kollaborativen Umgebung. Wir glauben daran, außergewöhnliches Talent und Engagement anzuerkennen.
• Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket, das den Wert widerspiegelt, den wir unseren Teammitgliedern und ihren Beiträgen zum dauerhaften Erbe der Maison beimessen. Zu Van Cleef & Arpels zu kommen bedeutet auch, aus Richemont zu kommen, einem weltweit führenden Luxusunternehmen, das eine Welt voller Möglichkeiten bietet, in renommierten Maisons zu wachsen, die jeweils für ihre einzigartige Kunst und ihr Erbe erneuert wurden. Bewerben Sie sich online. Wenn Ihr Profil ausgewählt ist: Sie werden vom Talent Acquisition Team für ein erstes Online-Interview kontaktiert. Ein Boutique-basiertes Interview wird folgen, um das Management-Team zu treffen. Anschließend treffen Sie den Retail Manager und HR Business Partner für den Schweizer Markt. jobs.description: Reference code: JR132467 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Visual Merchandising team at our headquarters in Schaffhausen, we are looking for an INTERN VISUAL MERCHANDISING (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: October 2026 As Intern for our Visual Merchandising Team, you will gain a fascinating insight into the world of IWC. You will be able to enhance your Project Management skills as part of a highly motivated and efficient team. During the internship, you will provide mainly administrative support in a creative environment and gain valuable insights into our work processes. YOUR MISSION AT IWC. Project management for various topics related to our upcoming new Retail and Wholesale campaigns Project Management of customised displays Creation of basic and seasonal Visual Merchandising guidelines Maintenance support for our Visual Merchandising evaluation tool Yoobic Sourcing and ordering of decoration articles Creating orders of VM articles in SAP Organizing and following up on transportation orders General administrative team-support (ordering, invoicing, communication etc.) HOW YOU BECOME PART OF THE JOURNEY. Currently enrolled in or recently completed Bachelor or Master’s degree in Business / Marketing or equivalent studies Proficient use of Microsoft Office: Excel, Power Point, Word, SAP experience is a plus Experience in the field of visual merchandising is a plus Fluency in English is required, German is a plus Exact, insistent, dainty way of working with a strong eye for details combined with a feeling and affinity for luxury Hands-on mentality and service-oriented mindset WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US. IWC offers you a challenging working environment: rooted in Switzerland, but operating successfully internationally. We combine tradition with innovation and attach great importance to change management, training and further education as well as personal development. Find below a selection of fringe benefits provided by us: Daily food & beverage allowance of CHF 7, redeem-able in the in-house restaurant and selected restaurants in Schaffhausen. Yearly health insurance contribution of CHF 2'340 for full-time contracts. 25 days vacation annually (30 days as of the age of 50), 5 additional bridge compensation days. Special conditions on selected IWC & Richemont products. Diverse health & wellbeing initiatives and programs, including financial support for external childcare. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) for sport enthusiasts. Attractive workplace adjacent to the river rhine, inviting for social activities amongst colleagues. Memorable internal events (Christmas, summer after work drinks, etc.). And many more! Sonderkonditionen für ausgewählte IWC & Richemont Produkte. Verschiedene Gesundheits- und Wohlbefindensinitiativen und -programme, einschließlich finanzieller Unterstützung für externe Kinderbetreuung. IWC Sport Club (est. 1972) für Sportbegeisterte. Attraktiver Arbeitsplatz neben dem Flusshein, der zu sozialen Aktivitäten unter Kollegen einlädt. Denkwürdige interne Ereignisse (Weihnachten, Sommer nach der Arbeit Getränke, etc.). Und viele mehr! Code de référence: JR132467 Nous sommes des fabricants. Des penseurs. Des stratèges. Des conteurs. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous avons été façonnés par la tradition, alimentés par le progrès et animés par les gens. Manifestations internes mémorables (Noël, boissons de l'été après le travail, etc.). Et bien d'autres ! jobs.title: Senior Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132534 Buccellati is a renowned Italian high-jewellery Maison founded in 1919, admired for its craftmanship and the uniqueness of its creations. Today, the Buccellati jewels stand out for their design and for the techniques used to create them, such as the hand-engraving technique, dating back to the ancient goldsmithing traditions of the Italian “bottega” during the Renaissance times. Buccellati has been part of the Global Luxury Group Richemont since September 2019, but the Buccellati family is still present in the Company with top level managerial functions. Buccellati boutiques are present in the most important cities and in the most prestigious Malls of the world. We are looking for enthusiastic, passionate, dynamic people to join our new retail team in Geneva! Main purpose: The Boutique Senior Sales Associate is a fully engaged individual who is committed to contributing to the success of Buccellati boutique in Geneva, with the ambition to grow with the Maison. He/she is developing his/her client portfolio while investing time and efforts in the boutique life, operations and actions and transmitting knowledge and passion to the clients. Your mission: You will become a Brand Ambassador of Buccellati Maison in the Boutique as well as at external events, and you will be responsible for delivering a unique client experience by sharing memorable inspiring moments. You will foster trusted relationships with clients all along the journey with the Maison. You will contribute in developing a deep understanding and knowledge of the Maison to convey its brand DNA, recognizable craftmanship and innovation in all its creations. You will be part of a team, transmitting and sharing knowledge with the other team members, actively participating in the day-to-day boutique life. Your 
• Responsibilities: Sales performance & customer service: Contribute to the boutique achieving its sales targets; Provide clients with the utmost level of customer service in accordance with the Maison standards; Perfectly master the steps of a sale (welcome, discover and understand, convince, close and develop); Ensure that all sales are processed in accordance with required procedures using the systems provided; Cultivate strong client relationships, delivering outstanding client service and treatment; providing a friendly environment which includes greeting and acknowledging every customer, maintaining outstanding standards and solid product knowledge; Adapt approach according to the client needs and motivations; Assist and support after sales clients in accordance with Maison values; provide recommendations that will grant an exceptional client experience; Stock management and merchandising: Provide feedback in processing and replenishing merchandise; participate in receiving and monitoring floor stock; Actively participate in the visual merchandising of the Boutique implementing required guidelines. Assist in floor moves, merchandising, display maintenance, and store housekeeping, including cleaning the products and displays; Assist in the inventory process, including but not limited to stock counting and special projects as needed; Assist in completing prices changes within the Boutique when required; Boutique operations and cash management: Accurately and efficiently complete all sales transactions and maintain proper cash records at the Boutique’s register; Master the process of opening and closing of the boutique; Adhere to all Company policies, procedures and practices; Implement discounts and gratuities under supervision of Boutique manager; Comply with all safety regulations and Boutique operational procedures including security; 4. Product knowledge & sales techniques: Maintain an awareness of all product knowledge information; Learns about the creations and the products, transmitting the passion and values of the Maison; Master the Brand's sales techniques as per training received; Attendance to required training; Assist clients with their returns and queries ensuring that brand image is enhanced and clients expectations are met; 5. Presentation & visibility: Maintain boutique tidiness, decoration and visual merchandising in line with the visual merchandising guidelines; Report maintenance issues to the Boutique Manager; Represent the Brand by wearing the appropriate provided uniform; Represent the Brand instore and at local events under the direction of Boutique Manager; 6. Client Relationships: Cultivate strong relationships and develop client loyalty; Efficiently develop the client portfolio and share actions with the Boutique Manager; Execute targeted CRM actions; Your 
• Profile: At least 5 - 8 years of previous experience in luxury retail, in the Jewellery / High Jewellery universe Ability to work in a fast-paced retail store environment MS Office experience required Fluency in French and English is mandatory, Italian is an advantage; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are required; Confidence in handling high-value transactions; Well established local and international VIP customers portfolio; Track record of high levels sales; Strong understanding of Customer Service needs and Customer (internal and external) priorities; Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and with precision; Self-Starter with Team-Player approach; Must be available to work retail hours including in the evenings, during weekends and to travel for trainings, client events, conferences; Similar Jobs Sales Associate Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Boutique Manager Save Geneva, Switzerland Buccellati Sales Associate Save Tivoli, Italy Buccellati

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR132534 Buccellati ist ein renommiertes italienisches Hochschmuckhaus, das 1919 gegründet wurde und für seine Handwerkskunst und die Einzigartigkeit seiner Kreationen bewundert wird. Heute zeichnen sich die Juwelen von Bucellati durch ihr Design und die zu ihrer Herstellung verwendeten Techniken aus, wie die Handgravurtechnik, die auf die alten Goldschmiedetraditionen der italienischen Bucellati zurückgeht und seit September 2019 Teil der Global Luxury Group Richemont ist, aber die Bucellati-Familie ist immer noch mit erstklassigen Managementfunktionen im Unternehmen präsent. Bucellati Boutiquen sind in den wichtigsten Städten und in den renommiertesten Malls der Welt präsent. Wir suchen enthusiastische, leidenschaftliche, dynamische Menschen, die sich unserem neuen Einzelhandelsteam in Genf anschließen! Hauptzweck: Die Boutique Senior Sales Associate ist eine voll engagierte Person, die sich dafür einsetzt, zum Erfolg der Bucellati Boutique in Genf beizutragen, mit dem Ziel, mit der Maison zu wachsen. Er / sie entwickelt sein / ihr Kundenportfolio, investiert Zeit und Mühe in das Boutique-Leben, Operationen und Aktionen und vermittelt Wissen und Leidenschaft an die Kunden. Ihre Mission: Sie werden Markenbotschafter von Bucellati Home in der Boutique sowie bei externen Veranstaltungen und Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, ein einzigartiges Kundenerlebnis zu bieten, indem Sie unvergessliche Momente teilen. Sie werden vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Kunden während der gesamten Reise mit der Maison pflegen. Sie werden dazu beitragen, ein tiefes Verständnis und Wissen über die Maison zu entwickeln, um ihre Marken-DNA, anerkannte Handwerkskunst und Innovation in all ihren Kreationen zu vermitteln. Sie werden Teil eines Teams sein, Wissen weitergeben und mit den anderen Teammitgliedern teilen und aktiv am täglichen Boutique-Leben teilnehmen. Ihr
• Verantwortung: Verkaufsleistung & Kundenservice: Trägt dazu bei, dass die Boutique ihre Verkaufsziele erreicht; Den Kunden ein Höchstmaß an Kundenservice gemäß den Maison-Standards bieten; Perfekt beherrschen die Schritte eines Verkaufs; Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Verkäufe in Übereinstimmung mit den erforderlichen Verfahren mit den zur Verfügung gestellten Systemen verarbeitet werden; Starke Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen, hervorragenden Kundenservice und -behandlung bieten; ein freundliches Umfeld schaffen, das die Ökologisierung und Identifizierung jedes Kunden umfasst, die Aufrechterhaltung stehender Standards und solides Produktwissen; Anpassung des Ansatzes an die Bedürfnisse und Motivationen des Kunden; Unterstützen und unterstützen Sie Kunden nach dem Verkauf in Übereinstimmung mit den Maison-Werten; geben Sie Empfehlungen, die eine außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrung bieten; Lagerverwaltung und Merchandising: Feedback bei der Verarbeitung und Auffüllung von Waren geben; am Empfang und der Überwachung des Bodenbestands teilnehmen; Aktiv am visuellen Merchandising der Boutique teilnehmen, um die erforderlichen Richtlinien umzusetzen. Unterstützung bei Bodenbewegungen, Merchandising, Display-Wartung und Lagerhaltung, einschließlich der Reinigung der Produkte und Displays; Unterstützung beim Inventarprozess, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Bestandsplanung und spezielle Projekte bei Bedarf; Unterstützung beim Abschluss von Preisänderungen innerhalb der Boutique bei Bedarf; Boutique-Operationen und Cash-Management: Alle Verkaufstransaktionen genau und effizient abschließen und eigene Kassenaufzeichnungen im Boutique Master den Prozess der Eröffnung und Schließung der Boutique führen; Befolgen Sie alle Richtlinien, Verfahren und Praktiken des Unternehmens; Implementierungsrabatte und Trinkgelder unter Aufsicht des Boutique-Managers; Befolgen Sie alle Sicherheitsvorschriften und Boutique-Betriebsverfahren einschließlich Sicherheit; 4. Produktwissen & Verkaufstechniken: Achten Sie auf alle Produktwissensinformationen; Erfahren Sie mehr über die Kreationen und Produkte, übermitteln Sie die Leidenschaft und die Werte der Maison; Meistern Sie die Verkaufstechniken der Marke gemäß erhaltenem Training; Warten Sie, um eine Schulung zu erfordern; Unterstützung der Kunden bei ihren Rücksendungen und Anfragen, um sicherzustellen, dass das Markenimage verbessert und die Erwartungen der Kunden erfüllt werden; 5. Präsentation und Sichtbarkeit: Pflegen Sie Boutique-Geschick, Dekoration und Visual Merchandising im Einklang mit den Visual Merchandising-Richtlinien; Melden Sie Wartungsprobleme an den Boutique-Manager; Repräsentieren Sie die Marke, indem Sie die entsprechende bereitgestellte Uniform hören; Repräsentieren Sie den Markenshop und bei lokalen Veranstaltungen unter der Leitung des Boutique-Managers; 6. Kundenbeziehungen: Starke Beziehungen aufbauen und Kundenbindung entwickeln; Kundenportfolio effektiv entwickeln und Aktionen mit dem Boutique-Manager teilen; gezielte CRM-Aktionen durchführen; Ihre

jobs.description: Reference code: JR132527 We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us. To support our Social Media & Content Team we are looking for an INTERN SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT (100%) Duration: 6 months Start: November 2026 Join our team and become a key player in shaping our social media and content marketing campaigns. Reporting to the Team Lead, Social Media & Content, you will manage social media channels, develop engaging content, and collaborate with external and internal teams on innovative projects. This role also offers the opportunity to acquire an overview of the entire global brand marketing campaign scope, from orchestration to implementation. We are looking for someone with a passion for luxury, strong communication skills, and a proactive approach.
